name: open-bridge-mods
description: Claude Code mods that ship with open-bridge (function hooks, early access). Add from the Bridge folder with: claude plugin marketplace add ./mods --scope local

plugins.name: cockpit-relay
plugins.description: Lets the Bridge cockpit ask this Claude Code session: heartbeat, signed questions from the cockpit as prompts, answers written back, in any terminal (cmux, tmux or plain). Active only with cockpit.enabled and cockpit.relay in bridge-config.yaml; never in an agent tab.
